parts.t: BERKELEY VILLAGE! Discover this stunning 3 bed + den, 2.5 bath home featuring an expansive west-facing rooftop deck. Enjoy the open-concept main floor with a large kitchen, freestanding island with bar seating, and top-of-the-line KitchenAid stainless steel appliances. The living area offers serene views of the green amenity space. A powder room and den, perfect for a home office, complete this floor. The master bedroom boasts a luxurious ensuite with quartz countertops, a frameless glass shower, and a rain shower head. Two more bedrooms and a 4-piece bath add convenience. The incredible rooftop deck comes equipped with a TV hookup and gas BBQ outlet, ideal for entertaining. Additional features include a side-by-side double car garage. OPEN HOUSE JULY 20/21: 1PM-3PM!
